items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: We had Nick Turner, another bass record. ... I had Nick Turner on the Suze for MWM on the drum roll.

ctx.x: So you got a real close song, didn't you?

That was the first bass song. And then when we went up a little further, when we added Geechee Robinson, another drum roll. We had Nick Turner, another bass record. I had Jimmy Johnson on the string bass. And I had Nick Turner on the Suze for MWM on the drum roll. And then later on I added Harold Holmes, who's now in Canada, who did most of my arranging. And as we traveled over the country, I added here, subtracted, added and subtracted.
And I found the change in the years. Did you ever play any other state fairs? You want to start it by now or is it?

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Nick Turner got sick in this little small town in the area. The undertaker wanted to bury him before he died. And we had to leave town. When we came back, we had to take Nick away from there.

ctx.x: What about if a guy got sick? And you're on the road.

That's another question. It's hard for me to answer. I don't remember anybody getting sick, but one time was Turner, wasn't it? What about that? Well, that was in later years. But Henry Turner got real sick in a little town of Ashland, Kentucky, I think. It was in the hills. And we had to...no, I'm sorry. Another fellow, Buddy Collins. He was from here. I don't know if you ever hear any talk about him. He was a vocalist. You've told me about him. Yeah. Well, Nick Turner got sick in this little small town in the…
I don't know if he's still going or not. You were going to say something?

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: First band, they used three basses. You had three basses? Two string basses and Nick on the tuba.

ctx.x: Let's see if there's anything else we didn't go over. What kind of parts did Nick Turner play? Henry Turner, what was his name?
Nick, Nick played the tuba and doubled on the valve trombone in the brass section.
Mm-hmm. Did he play string bass at all?
